title: Johnson Controls energy savings contract Phase 3
summary: On July 7, members voted 9–0 to finance Phase 3 of the Johnson Controls energy savings contract, up to $9,021,259 plus interest. A committee had backed it June 24 with an amendment allowing a lower final amount, using a tax-exempt lease purchase at 4.49 percent. The administration says Phase 1 is done and saving money, with net savings of $11.9 million on a roughly $25 million project.
